author: Cip
body:
I've been trying to get into map making a bit and have started on making some maps for atlas. One thing I noticed, however, is that there is no rank for people who just BUILD maps.

For someone like me who has no interest in learning XML, the rank of MapDev is something I wouldn't want to strive for as I wouldn't be able to do any of the coding for the maps. Therefore I think that we should introduce a Builder rank to encourage people to help strengthen the map pool and improve the gameplay on here as currently they aren't rewarded for their efforts. Any opinions welcomed.

EDIT : The rank could include access to a build server ON avicus to help the builders increase their productivity and these servers could be opened up with a senior member of staffs permission for map testing. Once again no it's not ripping off OCN it's common sense to improve the server.
